QuestInfo.name: [Star Force] Starstruck Dual Birks
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #p2081001#, who is quite worried about the star that fell into Minar Forest.
QuestInfo.1: #p2081001# is worried the #o8140112# monsters will destroy the forests. Those monsters have quite the appetite, so bring down their population before they eat up all the grass. \r\n
QuestInfo.2: You brought down the population of starstruck #o8140112# monsters for #p2081001#. Now #p2081001# wants to strengthen some weapons to prepare for the worst.\r\n

0.0: Hmm, the monsters turning vicious sounds like a real problem. What if they chop down the forest with their new axe-like claws? What if they eat the forest? The whole thing?

yes.0: It's those #r#o8140112##k monsters. They were always hungry fiends, but now they're uncontrollable. Take care of #b50 of them#k and the forest should be okay. Trust me. I've done the calculations. \r\n

no.0: I'd hate to see Minar Forest become a wasteland... Or somebody's lunch. \r\n

1.0: Did you get rid of the #o8140112# monsters and save the forest?

yes.0: Thank goodness, for now. But it also highlights all the horrible things that could come. We need more Star Force enhancements to neutralize our enemies' attacks!

default.0: Get rid of #b50#k #r#o8140112##k monsters and save Minar Forest.
